mentorSummary: The Department records now have the names you asked for, and I didn't publish the app. They appear in this order, with their Id and Label values unchanged: 1 Engineering (Engineering), 2 Finance (Finance), 3 HumanResources (Human Resources), 4 Sales (Sales). Before this change, the first three records had names that didn't match their labels (Finance, HumanResources and Engineering), and the last two were in the wrong order. I changed nothing else.
note: Kiro condensed this file from the poll response. The four changed elements are all IStaticEntityRecord. The first pending-changes event shows an intermediate name Engineering2 (a temporary name to avoid a clash); the second shows the final names.
